app_info.subtitle: Mortgage & loan payments
app_info.description: Exact mortgage, auto and personal-loan math with an interactive breakdown: monthly payment including taxes, insurance, HOA and PMI, full amortization with a downloadable schedule, extra-payment payoff savings, home affordability from income and debts, and refinance break-even. Estimates only, not financial advice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes the payment and amortization from the supplied numbers; nothing is stored or submitted.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access; it does not contact lenders or fetch rates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pure amortization math on the given amount, rate and term.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies debt-to-income rules to the supplied income and debts; nothing is stored.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access; no credit or lender systems are contacted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares two amortization schedules computed from the given terms.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

test_cases.description: Full mortgage payment with escrow items and PMI.
test_cases.user_prompt: What's my monthly payment on a $450,000 house with 10% down at 6.5% for 30 years? Property tax is 1.2%, insurance $1,800 a year, HOA $50 a month.
test_cases.expected_output: A payment breakdown (principal & interest, tax, insurance, HOA, PMI) with the total, total interest, payoff date, balance chart and a CSV schedule download.

test_cases.user_prompt: On a $300k mortgage at 7% over 30 years, how much do I save if I pay an extra $250 a month?
test_cases.expected_output: Interest saved, months saved and the earlier payoff date, with both balance curves on the chart.

test_cases.user_prompt: Monthly payment on a $32,000 car loan at 7.9% APR for 60 months
test_cases.expected_output: The monthly payment, total interest, total paid and payoff date with a yearly table.

test_cases.user_prompt: How much house can I afford making $120k a year with $600/month in car payments and $60k saved for a down payment at 6.5%?
test_cases.expected_output: A maximum price under the 28/36 rules, the monthly cost at that price, and a more conservative figure.

test_cases.user_prompt: Should I refinance my $380k balance from 7.25% with 27 years left to a new 30-year at 5.75% with $6,000 closing costs?
test_cases.expected_output: Old vs new payment, monthly savings, break-even months for the closing costs and the lifetime difference, with the longer term noted.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for current market rates.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it has no rate data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for property listings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me houses for sale in Austin under $500k
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it does not search listings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for investment advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I invest in index funds or pay off my mortgage early?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers conversationally; the app gives no advice.
